Name: temporal_multi_head_attention
Title: Temporal Multi-Head Self-Attention for Capturing Long-Range Dynamic Dependencies
Experiment: Integrate a multi-head temporal self-attention mechanism on top of the GRU/recurrent backbone. Compute attention scores across historical horizon timesteps to capture non-local periodic dependencies, evaluating gains on Test MSE and R2.

Name: adaptive_trend_seasonality_decomposition
Title: Adaptive Trend-Seasonality Decomposition Networks for Multivariate Physical Forecasting
Experiment: Incorporate a learnable moving-average decomposition block that separates high-frequency seasonal oscillations from low-frequency hydrodynamic/energy trends before passing through recurrent layers.

Name: residual_gated_recurrent_units
Title: Residual Gated Recurrence with Highway Connections for Gradient Highway Stabilization
Experiment: Add identity skip connections across recurrent state transitions to mitigate vanishing gradients in long-sequence forecasting, comparing training loss stability against the standard baseline.
